title: Running race distances explained
description: Compare common road-running distances and see how they appear in Kochi race listings.
intro: Race names can describe several distances at the same event. Check the specific category before registering: a marathon is a defined distance, while a running festival may also include shorter timed runs or a fun run.

entries.name: 3 km fun run
entries.description: The Federal Bank Kochi Marathon lists a 3 km Green Run alongside longer timed categories. A shorter event can have different timing and participant rules from the full marathon, so read the organizer’s category details.

entries.name: 5 km road race
entries.description: Five kilometres is a standard road-race distance in World Athletics rules. Kochi Navy Half Marathon also lists a 5 km fun run, illustrating why a half-marathon event may offer a shorter separate category.

entries.name: 10 km road race
entries.description: Ten kilometres is another standard road-race distance. Race organizers determine category-specific rules such as minimum age, timing and cut-off; check those details on the event page.

entries.name: Half marathon
entries.description: A half marathon covers 21.0975 km. Some event pages round this to 21.1 km for display, so compare the named category as well as the abbreviated number.

entries.name: Marathon
entries.description: The standard marathon distance is 42.195 km. It is a separate category from the half marathon and from the shorter races that might appear in the same festival.
